root_causes.title: Hill slope fixed to 1 on curves the authors fitted freely (cAMP 0.00 µg, βarrestin2 0.10 µg)
root_causes.summary: In the paper, footnote 'a' (Hill constrained to 1) sits only on the 0.50 µg cAMP row, and the Results say only that curve 'could not be fit to a 4-parameter model'. methods.json passed the footnote text on as a general rule with no row and no criterion, so each agent wrote its own failure rule, and those rules also fired on the cAMP control and the βarrestin2 0.10 µg curves. Keeping the pooled free 4PL for these rows reproduces all 10 cells to the published precision and matches the authors' Prism tabs. Secondary issue in the original: the paper never states an objective criterion, and the authors' tabs show '???' CIs on the curves they left free too.
root_causes.suggested_wording: Each condition was fit once to all independent-experiment values pooled with the 4-parameter model; only the 0.50 µg OX1 cAMP curve, for which Prism could not return a finite LogEC50 or Hill slope, was refit with the Hill slope fixed (Prism 3-parameter model), and ± values are the standard errors of the fitted parameters.

root_causes.title: Control (0.00 µg) group: 4 of the 8 mock columns used instead of all 8
root_causes.summary: r2 and r3 split the 8 deposited mock columns into an OX1 series and an OX2 series and used 4 of them. The authors fitted all 8 (48 Y values), and Tables 1 and 2 print the identical 0.00 µg row. The paper's 'n=4-8 independent experiments' (Table 1 note, Figure 2 legend) was dropped from methods.json, whose M2 says 'minimum n=4'. The data README, which says the 0.00 µg group is n=8, was withheld. r1 kept all 8 columns and scored A on these cells.
root_causes.suggested_wording: The mock-transfected (0.00 µg) control curve is shared by Tables 1 and 2 and pools all 8 independent experiments (4 run alongside OX1 and 4 alongside OX2 transfections).

root_causes.title: βarrestin2 control Emax is the observed mean at 10 µM, not a fitted plateau
root_causes.summary: Table 1 footnote b says the βarrestin2 control Emax is the experimentally observed value because the curve did not plateau. methods.json put that rule only under Table 2, cut out its criterion, and wrongly said it is absent from Table 1. The mean ± SEM of the 8 values at 10 µM is 16.54 ± 4.62, against the published 17 ± 4.6. Getting this value also requires all 8 columns (rc2).
root_causes.suggested_wording: For the mock-transfected βarrestin2 curve, which did not plateau, Emax is the mean ± SEM of the observed responses at 10 µM CP55,940 across all 8 control experiments.

root_causes.title: βarrestin2 control potency printed as a bound that contradicts the authors' own fit
root_causes.summary: The table prints pEC50 '<5 (>10000 nM)' for the βarrestin2 control, but the authors' Prism fit gives pEC50 5.60 (EC50 2.5 µM), inside the tested range. Their own Table 2 note uses a bound only when the estimate lies beyond 10,000 nM. No reading of the data reproduces the bound; the agents' values of 5.5-6.2 are what the data give.
root_causes.suggested_wording: For the mock-transfected βarrestin2 curve, which did not plateau by 10 µM, the fitted EC50 (2.5 µM) was judged unreliable and is reported by convention as pEC50 < 5 (EC50 > 10,000 nM), with no Hill slope given.

best_example.why: One change of reading (keep the pooled free 4-parameter fit and constrain only the footnoted 0.50 µg cAMP curve) puts 10 of the 17 failing cells exactly on the published values, and the authors' Prism tabs confirm it.
